validation_layer.name: veritas-sys
validation_layer.use: turn falsifier and baseline/null evidence into an explicit reality gate

validation_layer.name: aeternitas-sys
validation_layer.use: protect seed mutation before crystallization or policy promotion

processing_layer.name: helix-sys
processing_layer.use: plan-code-verify loop for reusable BTC measurements

processing_layer.name: mnemos-sys
processing_layer.use: decide what the Lab retains, decays or sends to redesign

processing_layer.name: kairos-sys
processing_layer.use: select advance, watch, redesign or reject from evidence friction

observation_layer.name: coherence-sys
observation_layer.use: check drift between intent, seed, artifacts, UI and simulator

observation_layer.name: triage-sys
observation_layer.use: rank next BTC Lab improvements by impact, cost and urgency

modus_invocation.promotion: only after baseline/null and runtime trace

tools_custom.name: btc_market_card
tools_custom.boundary: writes observe-only BTC data-card; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_exchange_ohlcv
tools_custom.boundary: writes exchange-native OHLCV robustness data-card across Bitstamp/Coinbase/Binance; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_first_hypothesis
tools_custom.boundary: consumes exchange OHLCV artifact and writes first falsifiable BTC hypothesis card; field admissibility only; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_timeframe_matrix
tools_custom.boundary: consumes BTC field artifacts and classifies requested timeframes as testable, watch-only or blocked; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_method_intake_card
tools_custom.boundary: turns BTC method language into method cards, missing definitions, THIA questions and next-test contracts; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_daily_inefficiency_candidate
tools_custom.boundary: consumes exchange OHLCV artifact and writes daily FVG/inefficiency proxy zones with matched adjacent controls; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_auto_ignite
tools_custom.boundary: gathers BTC value artifacts and writes a provisional LVN/Volume Profile proxy contract with explicit assumptions and nulls; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_volume_profile_lvn_proxy
tools_custom.boundary: tests the generated LVN/Volume Profile proxy against adjacent, opposite and shuffled-volume controls; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_policy_simulator
tools_custom.boundary: manual-only research simulator; measures declared BTC method policies against controls, walk-forward splits and parameter sensitivity before any cron/cycle/UI integration

tools_custom.name: btc_paper_simulation_ledger
tools_custom.boundary: reads BTC policy simulator and writes a paper simulation ledger: simulated research decisions, outcomes, error against normal BTC baseline and next adjustment hints; no data fetch and no order execution

tools_custom.name: btc_policy_mutation_contract
tools_custom.boundary: reads the daily gate, policy simulator, paper ledger and trajectory state; writes a first-class contract for BTC method/policy self-adjustment without applying mutation or executing orders

tools_custom.name: btc_daily_closed_evidence_gate
tools_custom.boundary: reads BTC daily artifacts and writes a policy-mutation guard that separates closed daily evidence from current open-candle refresh noise; public_claim=false; trading_signal=false; operational=false

tools_custom.name: btc_autology_artifacts
tools_custom.boundary: writes first-class Mnemos/Kairos/Coherence artifacts from local BTC value artifacts: retention/decay, phase selection and coherence checks; no data fetch and no cycle execution

tools_custom.name: btc_retention_regime_selector
tools_custom.boundary: reads Mnemos, Kairos, daily gate, policy contract, paper ledger and trajectory state; returns explicit retain/decay/reject/watch decisions without applying hard decay, method-policy mutation or orders

tools_custom.name: btc_cognitive_state
tools_custom.boundary: reads current BTC Lab artifacts and writes the observable cognitive/autological state: learning, adjustment, layer gaps and next mutation; no data fetch and no cycle execution
